claim_scope: Protocol-specific female tethered-flight positive-control tests of DNg02 activation and targeted-pair-count population dependence. Targeted pairs are a driver-line proxy, not a measured per-fly recruited-cell count or free-flight gain.

split.rule: Every fly, activation trial, time bin, and derivative belonging to one driver line remains in one immutable calibration, validation, or held-out partition.
prohibited: random fly split across a line

protocols.open_loop: Striped-drum open-loop trials are fit, predicted, resampled, and reported separately.
protocols.closed_loop: Closed-loop stripe trials are fit, predicted, resampled, and reported separately.

response.conversion: multiply by pi/180 exactly before scoring
response.window: Must be frozen from source methods and code in the intake manifest before held-out access.

metrics.integrity: All registered exact-zero digest, driver-line-overlap, protocol-pooling, duplicate-trial, model-selection, and non-finite counts must equal zero.
metrics.activation_effect: For each protocol separately, the one-sided 95% driver-line-cluster lower confidence bound of activation-induced wingbeat-amplitude change must be greater than 0 rad.
metrics.population_slope: For each protocol separately, the one-sided 95% driver-line-cluster lower confidence bound of amplitude change per targeted pair must be greater than 0 rad per targeted pair.
metrics.curve_noninferiority: For each protocol separately, the one-sided 95% driver-line-cluster upper bound of candidate curve RMSE divided by a calibration-only line-mean null RMSE must not exceed 1.0.

identity_limits: The public HDF5 layout does not provide a durable globally unique biological-subject identifier reviewed across every protocol.
Targeted-pair annotations describe driver lines and are not exact recruited-cell measurements for each fly.
